step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor configured as the core of a common-gate Colpitts oscillator. The gate is AC grounded via the bias voltage, the drain connects to an LC tank, and the source connects to a capacitive feedback divider.

paper_reference.title: A Study of Phase Noise in Colpitts and LC-Tank CMOS Oscillators

phase_noise.description: Phase noise of the oscillator (proxy measured as output noise spectral density at resonance)

sky130_expected.calculation: Thermal noise of tank and transistor peaking at resonance
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct phase noise (dBc/Hz) requires PSS/PNOISE. In standard SPICE, we measure the noise spectral density peak at the tank's resonant frequency.

gain.description: Transimpedance gain of the LC tank at resonance

sky130_expected.reasoning: With an effective parallel tank resistance of 20kOhm, the transimpedance gain (V/I) peaks at 86 dB ohms.
Adapted from the paper's 3V to the standard 1.8V for the SKY130 0.18um process.

efficiency.description: DC to RF power conversion efficiency

sky130_expected.reasoning: Class A oscillators typically achieve 20-40% efficiency depending on the bias point and tank Q.
With L=1uH and C_eq=0.5pF (two 1pF capacitors in series), the resonant frequency is approximately 225 MHz.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure oscillator gain, noise spectral density (phase noise proxy), oscillation frequency, and efficiency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Colpitts Oscillator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
XM1 VTANK VB N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.54
I_tail N1 0 10u

* LC Tank
L1 VDD VTANK 1u
R1 VDD VTANK 20k

* Capacitive Feedback Divider
C1 VTANK N1 1p
C2 N1 0 1p

* AC injection for Gain measurement
I_ac 0 VTANK dc 0 ac 1

* Initial condition to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(VTANK)=0 v(N1)=0

.control
* 1. AC Analysis for Gain
ac dec 100 100Meg 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VTANK)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db

* 2. Noise Analysis for Phase Noise proxy
noise v(VTANK) VVDD dec 10 100Meg 1G
meas noise max_noise max onoise_spectrum

* 3. Transient Analysis for Oscillation and Efficiency
tran 0.1n 200n
* Measure frequency using zero-crossings around VDD (1.8V)
meas tran t1 trig v(VTANK) val=1.8 rise=10 targ v(VTANK) val=1.8 rise=11
let osc_freq = 1/t1
print osc_freq

* Measure amplitude
meas tran vmax max v(VTANK) from=100n to=200n
meas tran vmin min v(VTANK) from=100n to=200n
let amp = vmax - vmin
print amp

* Measure DC power
meas tran id_avg avg i(VVDD) from=100n to=200n
let dc_power = -id_avg * 1.8
print dc_power

* Calculate Efficiency
let p_rf = (amp/2)*(amp/2) / (2 * 20000)
let efficiency = (p_rf / dc_power) * 100
print efficiency

* Supply voltage
let supply_v = 1.8
print supply_v

quit
.endc
